title: Integral and rational scalar balancing cube before completion
statement: Let l be prime, E and F finite extensions of Q_l, i:E→F a Q_l-algebra embedding, g:X→Y between noetherian finite-dimensional l-invertible schemes, and aXE,aYE,aXF,aYF,agE,agF,bX,bY normalized continuous realization, pullback and scalar data [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data]. Let m be an AmbientMixed comparison [lem-per-continuous-ambient-mixed-coherence]. Put eWE=aWE.integralIso.hom≫aWE.inclusion and similarly eWF, S_W=pbcEmbeddingAmbientTensor(i,W), B_W=pbcDerivedExtend(bW.coefficient), and P_E=derivedPull(g,agE.coefficient), P_F=derivedPull(g,agF.coefficient). Let c_W(K):extend(eWF)(S_W(K))≅B_W(extend(eWE)(K)) be the composite of the two specified pbcReductionNormalization isomorphisms, using bW.square, namely integralBalance. Let o:S_Y⋙actualDerivedPull_F≅actualDerivedPull_E⋙S_X be pbcScalarOrdinaryPullIso [lem-pbc-scalar-ambient-operation-comparisons]. For EVERY ambient integral derived object K over the completed E-coefficients on Y, without completeness, boundedness or constructibility assumptions, P_F(c_Y(K))≫m.ambient(extend(eYE)(K))≫B_X(agE.ambient(K)) = agF.ambient(S_Y(K))≫extend(eXF)(o(K))≫c_X(actualDerivedPull_E(K)). This is an equation before completion, independent of the raw functors and all realization comparisons.

proof.text: On ordinary modules, use the all-scalar section equations of Along.balance and AmbientMixed.ordinary and the normalized integral scalar/pullback comparison. The two scalar associators flatten a rational coefficient, an integral coefficient and a pulled generator to the product of their two images times the same pulled generator. The coefficient squares identify the products. Tensor balancing and sheafification extend this equality from generators to all sections.

Resolve an arbitrary integral complex by a flat-term K-flat complex. Ringed pullback and extension of scalars preserve that resolving class. Apply the ordinary equality degreewise, and substitute Along.ambient_normalization, AmbientMixed.ambient_normalization, the integral derived scalar/pullback normalization, and the derived tensor associators. Cancel the computation counits, which are invertible on these representatives. Naturality across the resolving quasi-isomorphism gives the asserted equality for every ambient K.

theorem continuousMixedOrdinaryBalance (i : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] F)
    {X Y : Base.{u} l} (g : X.scheme ⟶ Y.scheme)
    (aXE : At l E X) (aYE : At l E Y) (aXF : At l F X) (aYF : At l F Y)
    (agE : Along l E g aXE aYE) (agF : Along l F g aXF aYF)
    (bX : FieldChange l E F i X aXE aXF) (bY : FieldChange l E F i Y aYE aYF)
    (m : AmbientMixed l E F i g aXE aYE aXF aYF agE agF bX bY)
    (K : PbcCompletedDerived Y.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) :
    (derivedPull g agF.coefficient).map
        (bY.integralBalance l E F i Y aYE aYF K).hom ≫
        m.ambient.hom.app ((pbcDerivedExtend (aYE.integralIso.hom ≫ aYE.inclusion)).obj K) ≫
        (pbcDerivedExtend bX.coefficient).map (agE.ambient.hom.app K) =
      agF.ambient.hom.app ((pbcEmbeddingAmbientTensor l E F i Y.scheme).obj K) ≫
        (pbcDerivedExtend (aXF.integralIso.hom ≫ aXF.inclusion)).map
          ((pbcScalarOrdinaryPullIso l E F i g).hom.app K) ≫
        (bX.integralBalance l E F i X aXE aXF
          ((pbcActualDerivedPull g (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).obj K)).hom
